overrideHooks.basis: 1.21 asks isDirect() where 1.20.6 asked isIndirect() (the Warden's hurt; 1.21 also asks it in the explosion damage calculator): a 1.20.6 damage source class answers with its isIndirect() negated; its super call reaches 1.20.6's body, given back (CbEntityDamageSourceMixin)

net/minecraft/class_6028.<init>(FLjava/u.basis: 1.21's AnimalPanic panics on the damage type that hurt the mob (a tag function); a 1.20.6 one on its predicate: made with 1.21's default function and handed the predicate, which then decides shouldPanic 1.20.6's way (CbEntityAnimalPanicMixin)

net/minecraft/class_1350.<init>(Lnet/min.basis: 1.21's FollowOwnerGoal teleports through the animal, which decides by canFlyToOwner() whether it may land on leaves; 1.20.6's goal decided by its canFly: a goal made with canFly makes its animal answer true (CbEntityTamableFlyMixin)

net/minecraft/class_4153.<init>(Lnet/min.basis: PoiManager hands chunk I/O failures to a reporter since 1.21; 1.20.6's reported nowhere (CbLevelChunks.NO_REPORTS, as for SectionStorage)
